activity.notes: ATLAS uses a distinct Kingdom of Odoacer identity for Odoacer's 476–493 regime. It deliberately does not reuse the currently contaminated multi-era generic Kingdom of Italy record that is under separate polity-identity repair.

sources.title: Odoacer — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford identifies Odoacer as ruler of Italy from 476 to 493, after deposing Romulus Augustulus in 476.

sources.title: Odoacre — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani describes Odoacer as the first ruler to hold royal power in Italy after the deposition of Romulus Augustulus and records his death in 493.
